display.title: {"text": "VI. Observatory and Horizon Beacon"}
description: &6STATION VI&r  Set an Observatory Lens at the station, chart three realms, defeat two great legends and pass one Horizon Trial.
&eWhy:&r The capstone: the Horizon Beacon, the full survey desk and the post-campaign Gauntlet.
&7- An Observatory Lens placed at the station&r
&7- Members have entered 3 of 7 realms (Nether, Aether, Undergarden, Otherside, End, Bumblezone, Moon)&r
&7- Pass one Horizon Trial (Tides, Cinders or Void) at a Gateway&r
&eContribution (consumed once):&r 8x amethyst block, 4x gold block, 32x brass ingot, 32x glass
&eUnlocks:&r The Horizon Beacon (a light the whole valley can see), the explorer's hat, and full survey charts. Post-campaign: the Horizon Gauntlet.
&7Commission it from the charter panel. This quest completes by itself when the station records it.&r
&aDo:&r Commission Observatory and Horizon Beacon at your charter.
&6You get:&r Beyond the line: every legend, every realm, and the Horizon Gauntlet.
